blockers.title: The purported structured parity/loss goldens are invalid, incomplete, and leave an explicit v2 repair untouched
detail: Both previewFixtures claim conformance to opensip-sarif-golden.1 while supplying hostCanonicalResult.sha256='RESERVED-until-DR-006-recipe'. That value is 28 characters, violates the input schema's own minLength=maxLength=64 rule, is not a digest, and names no digest-pinned canonical input. The two newly structured fixture instances therefore fail the candidate's own record type.

expectedWhenProduced is still not an exact expected projection. It requires only schemaId and schemaVersion under runPropertiesOpensip, omitting requiredAlways.truncation; resultPropertiesOpensip is merely an unconstrained array and does not require each result's requiredAlways.artifactRefs. It supplies no values or result-item schema, and no produced=true fixture exercises Run/Finding/Coverage/verdict/truncation/artifact-reference parity or loss. The note additionally groups verdict with DR-006-owned values even though the member map makes verdict conditional on the host result, not DR-006.

The frozen SARIFV2-B1 minimum repair also required a deterministic native location/related-location rule. v3 does not roster or change machineSurface.nativeMappings: it still joins the full result.locations[].physicalLocation.artifactLocation.uri path to the bare result.relatedLocations[] container with 'and', without a related-location URI path or placement rule.
blockers.impact: The successor cannot validate its own preview records and still supplies neither one executable produced parity/loss golden nor one deterministic complete expected projection. OBL-2/OBL-3 remain renderer-dependent, so the frozen v2 blocker is not closed.
blockers.minimumRepair: Make produced=false records a valid tagged variant that does not require a fictitious canonical-result digest, or point them at a real 64-hex digest-pinned input. Add at least one produced=true, digest-pinned parity/loss input and exact expected object that enforces truncation, artifactRefs, and all applicable conditional members with the declared ownership. State the deterministic primary-location versus related-location URI mapping. Keep Run/Finding/Coverage values opaque and DR-006-gated.

shouldFix.title: FC-NONAUTH's ride:null falsely makes its Coverage subcase preview-active
shouldFix.detail: FC-NONAUTH now has a ride member, but its rideNote says the whole active fixture has no parked dependency while its requires text includes a discarded-Coverage negative. The same candidate requires coverage to be omitted while DR-006 is inactive and records Coverage semantics on ID-DEP-S2/DR-006. Thus that subcase cannot be preview-active under ride:null. FC-OUTFAIL's ride:null does not have this contradiction.
shouldFix.minimumRepair: Split FC-NONAUTH so the D9/HostTermination and otherwise available verdict authority negatives remain active with ride:null, while its Coverage-preservation subcase is explicitly conditional on ID-DEP-S2/DR-006; or remove the Coverage subcase until that ride activates.

File 01 reproduced 40ab9a3e..., file 08 reproduced 1cdcf9d4..., file 01 lines 108-133 exactly matched projectionTextCarriedVerbatim, and the unique live DR-122 row exactly matched rowVerbatim at line 304.

The recorded COORD digest 12d192f7... reproduced from repository commit 2327cf89106e3c58a317bf8b570697f3505dbbb8. The live b9819d6e... file is that exact snapshot plus 7,012 appended bytes, so no finding rests on append-only drift.

Each preview fixture's purported sha256 is the same 28-character RESERVED string despite a required 64-character input member. expectedWhenProduced omits run truncation, gives resultPropertiesOpensip no item schema or artifactRefs requirement, supplies no values, and has no produced=true instance.
